exposure: Neurological function (Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination scores)
outcome: Motor skills (Alberta Infant Motor Scale scores)
cohort: 50 preterm infants with a mean gestational age of 32.0 weeks and mean birth weight of 1645.2 grams, assessed between 2 and 6 months of corrected age after hospital discharge in an outpatient follow-up program.
finding: A strong and significant correlation was found between neurological function and motor skills in preterm infants during the first months of life.
cross-section timing: between two to six months of corrected age
